SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. S. B. REGISTRY.
File No.
4213
Special Branch, S. 2 Station,
21. 12. 32
Date December 20, 1932

REPORT

Subject (in full)........ Departure of Li Gen Ko.

Made by........ D. S. Umemoto ........Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

Li Gen Ko, who arrived in Shanghai on September 19, 1932,
with the object of making personal investigations into the
"Hongkew Bomb Case" of April 29, left here for Tokio by the s.s.
"Nagasaki Maru" on December 18, 1932, During his sojourn in
Shanghai he interviewed many leading Japanese residents including
Consul-General Ishii and Military and Naval Officers. According
to his statement, he was unable to obtain information of an
interesting nature from Korean sources because he was looked upon
by them as being pro-Japanese.

This individual left his lodgings at No. 106 Range Road
on December 17 leaving an unsettled account for $54.00, the
payment of which sum is now being claimed by the boarding-house
proprietor from the Japanese Consulate.

[签名]
D. S. Umemoto
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

事由（全称）........ 李根高离境。

呈报人........ D. S. Umemoto ........转呈人 [签名] D.I.

李根高于1932年9月19日抵达上海，旨在对4月29日的“虹口炸弹案”进行个人调查，他于1932年12月18日乘“长崎丸”号轮船由此启程前往东京。在上海逗留期间，他会见了许多日本侨民领袖，包括总领事石井以及陆海军军官。据其陈述，由于被朝鲜人视为亲日派，他未能从朝鲜方面获得任何具有价值的信息。

此人于12月17日离开其位于兰路106号的寓所，留下54.00美元的未结账款，目前寄宿处房东正向日本领事馆追讨该笔款项。

[签名]
D. S. Umemoto

Li Gen Ko previously visited Shanghai in November
1929. On that occasion he was sentenced to 7 days' imprisonment
by the local Japanese Consular Court on a charge of certain
trivial fraudulent acts which he had committed during the
course of his visits to the Headquarters of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party and on leading Japanese residents. He left here
for Tokio in December 1929 following his release. Since then
he was in Tokio and in Manchuria working, as what he claims to
be, to bring about the better understanding and feeling between
Japanese and Koreans. His mother is living in Korea.

His movements are being carefully watched and a
report will be duly submitted on receipt of any further
information.

今年一月，并在盐崎医院接受治疗。每当资金短缺时，我便请求殖民事务大臣及其他政客提供必要经费。”

李根高曾于1929年11月访问过上海。在那次期间，他因在访问日本海军陆战队司令部及拜访日本侨民领袖过程中犯下某些轻微欺诈行为，被当地日本领事法庭判处监禁7天。获释后，他于1929年12月由此启程前往东京。此后，他在东京和满洲活动，据其自称，致力于促进日本人与朝鲜人之间的相互理解和感情。其母亲居住在朝鲜。

其行踪正受到严密监视，一旦收到进一步消息，将及时提交报告。
